info.title: Delivery Hub API contract
info.summary: Operations the Delivery Hub interface needs from the backend.
info.description:
Versioned contract between the frontend and the backend (ADR-16). Change 1 (`frontend`) uses it
with example data; change 2 (`backend`) implements it. The version in `info.version` is the
contract version recorded in the administrator's approval. Changing an approved contract needs
a new approval.

Conventions that apply to every operation:
- Amounts are decimal strings (never JSON numbers) so source precision is kept. An absent amount
  is `null`, never `"0"`.
- The incident date is `YYYY-MM-DD` with an optional `HH:MM` time in Europe/Madrid. When the
  source has no time, the time is `null`; `00:00` is never invented.
- System timestamps (`createdAt`, `confirmedAt` and similar) are UTC instants.
- Provider values are lowercase (`uber eats`, `just eat`, `glovo`). The key of an incident is
  provider plus order ID.
- Errors use the `Error` schema. 401 means no valid session, 403 means authenticated but not
  authorized.

post.summary: Save a manual entry after the administrator reviewed and confirmed it
post.description:
A manual Uber Eats or Just Eat entry generates its email (decision P-12): the incident is
saved as `pending_send` together with one pending email, in the same transaction, and
nothing is sent by this operation. A Glovo entry generates no email and is claimed by hand.

get.summary: Dashboard figures, always stating the date used
get.description:
Criteria decided by the administrator (P-04). A claim is an incident with a claim date and a
recovery is an incident marked `resolved`. The recovery rate is recoveries divided by claims,
by number, and is `null` when there are no claims or the recovery date is the one used. Known
amounts are added up and the missing ones are counted; an absent amount is never counted as zero.

easyAuthSession.name: AppServiceAuthSession
easyAuthSession.description: Session cookie set by Easy Auth after Google sign-in. The frontend proxy forwards the identity to the API; the API trusts no other source.

Amount.description: Decimal amount in EUR as a string. Keeps the source decimals; sign is kept as received.

OptionalAmount.description: An `Amount`, or `null` when the source has no value. `null` is never zero.

IncidentTime.description: Optional `HH:MM` incident time in Europe/Madrid. `null` when the source has no time.

Timestamp.description: A UTC instant. The interface presents it in Europe/Madrid time.

Provider.description: Lowercase provider. Only `uber eats` and `just eat` generate email.

BatchState.description: Lifecycle of a batch. `uploaded`, `processing` and `in_review` are unconfirmed.

RowClass.description: Exclusive classification produced by the backend for each row.

IncidentStatus.description: Incident states. There is no transition from `send_error` back to `pending_send`.

IncidentCore.description: The business fields of an incident, as in the XLSX contract.

orderId.description: Alphanumeric text kept exactly as received.

branch.description: Lowercase branch, or `null` for an incident without branch ("Sin sucursal").

message.description: Message intended for the user, in Spanish.

Permission.description: Actions a role allows. Hiding an action in the interface never replaces API authorization.

identifier.description: Stable identifier of the authenticated user.

Sha256.description: SHA-256 of the uploaded file. The confirmation is bound to this reviewed version.

UploadGrant.description: Temporary create-only permission to upload one file directly to storage.

BatchSummary.description: Counts of a prepared batch. Nothing here is definitive until the batch is confirmed.

withoutEmail.description: Valid new incidents that generate no email (Glovo).

Rejection.description: Structure rejection of the whole file (RF-02).

detail.description: For example the name of the missing header.

IdenticalFileNotice.description: The file matches a previously confirmed one. It never replaces row-level deduplication.

RowFields.description:
The values of a row as read from the file, kept as text so nothing is rounded or repaired.
Provider and branch are already lowercase. An absent value is `null`.

Comparison.description: The existing incident compared with the file row, for a conflict.

reason.description: Reason shown to the user for every excluded row; `null` for a new row.

repeatedInFile.description: Row numbers of the other occurrences of the same key inside the file.

RowPage.description:
One page of rows. `total` counts the rows that match the filter and `totalsByClass` counts the
whole batch, so the totals are always present and no truncation is silent (RNF-01).

isFinal.description: False while P-03 is pending; the text is then only an example.

kind.description: Only the test recipient is allowed until real recipients are defined (P-01).

ConfirmationResult.description: The stored result of a confirmation. Repeating a confirmation returns the same result.

excludedAtConfirmation.description: Rows that became duplicates between review and confirmation (RF-10).

alreadyConfirmed.description: True when this response repeats a confirmation already stored.

OptionalDate.description: A calendar date as `YYYY-MM-DD`, or `null` when it has not happened. Used for claim and recovery dates.

Channel.description: Claims by email and manual Glovo claims are always kept apart.

Incident.description: A confirmed incident. The incident, claim and recovery dates are three distinct values.

batchId.description: The batch that created the incident, or `null` for a manual entry.

HistoryEntry.description: Append-only history of an incident. Corrections do not revert the batch or any email.

field.description: The value that changed. `previousValue` and `newValue` refer to it.

ManualCheckResult.description: Outcome of checking a manual entry by provider and order ID before it is reviewed.

ClaimRequest.description: Manual claim of a Glovo incident made outside the application. The channel is pending P-11.

incompleteCount.description: Incidents in the figure that have no claim amount, so the sum is incomplete.

recoveryRate.description: Recoveries over claims by number, with four decimals. `null` when there are no claims or the recovery date is the one used.

ageDays.description: Calendar days since the claim, in Europe/Madrid time. There is no threshold.

dateKind.description: The date every figure and filter uses. It is always stated to the user.

name.description: Lowercase branch name, as it must appear in the XLSX.

paused.description: Persistent. Pausing prevents new attempts; an attempt already started may finish.

sendingAvailable.description:
False when nothing can be sent (no mail server, sender or test recipient configured, or a
production environment without real recipients). The emails stay pending and none turns
into an error because of it.

unavailableReason.description: Why sending is unavailable, in Spanish, or `null` when it is available.

QueueEntry.description: One email. It has a single attempt; there is no retry, resend or cancel.

batchId.description: The batch that created the email, or `null` for the email of a manual entry.

reason.description: Reason for an `error` state, shown to the user.

errorKind.description:
`interrupted_unverified` means the result could not be verified; it does not prove the
email was not received.

BatchEmailProgress.description: A batch is completed when every email is `sent` or `error`. Completed does not mean all succeeded.

minIntervalSeconds.description: Minimum seconds between the start of consecutive attempts.

FilterBranch.name: branch
FilterBranch.description: A lowercase branch, or `none` for incidents without branch.

DateKind.name: dateKind
DateKind.description: Which date the range applies to.
